neighbours.label: a middle word-piece of rare Latinate adjectives ('exig-ent', 'evid-enti-ary', 'consc-ient-ious', 'Res-olute')
fire: The court found that exigent circumstances justified the search.
The judge ruled on several evidentiary questions before the trial.
She was a conscientious student who never missed a deadline.
The committee took an expedient approach to the budget crisis.
Philosophers have long argued about whether animals are sentient beings.
The novel's narrator is an omniscient voice that knows every secret.
The museum holds a deferential portrait of the old queen.
The training stresses experiential learning outside the classroom.
quiet: The court found that the police search was legal.
The judge ruled on several procedural questions before the trial.
She was a careful student who never missed a deadline.
The committee took a quick approach to the budget crisis.
Philosophers have long argued about whether animals have feelings.
The novel's narrator is a quiet voice that knows every secret.
The museum holds a formal portrait of the old queen.
The training stresses practical learning outside the classroom.
